assigned.title: An LGPL-compatible libmpv and FFmpeg the product may actually ship
assigned.acceptance: The libmpv and FFmpeg binaries the installer ships are built under terms this product may distribute, and the evidence is recorded rather than assumed. docs/DESKTOP_PLAYBACK.md section 9 names two traps and RESEARCH_PLAYBACK.md already found the equivalent defect elsewhere -- 'every prebuilt ffprobe on npm is a GPL-3.0 binary, and several declare otherwise' -- so a downloaded build is not evidence of its own licence. REQUIRED: the configure flags that keep the build LGPL are stated and reproducible, and any GPL-only component is named and excluded. REQUIRED: the written-offer and attribution obligations LGPL imposes on a shipped binary are satisfied by something in the installer, not by a sentence in a README nobody ships. REQUIRED: the exact upstream versions are pinned and recorded, because PW-0207's error mapping is built against a specific header. NOT IN SCOPE: any decoder whose distribution needs a patent licence this project does not hold -- if one is required, stop and report it as a commander decision rather than shipping it.

recommended.title: Updates, and a version the application can prove
recommended.acceptance: The application can tell a user what version it is and can update itself safely, or states plainly that it cannot yet and why. REQUIRED: an update mechanism whose payloads are signature-verified -- an updater that fetches and executes an unverified binary is a remote code execution feature, and SECURITY.md's threat list already ranks unauthorized access above convenience. REQUIRED: the update endpoint is pinned and allowlisted like every other egress in this repository. REQUIRED: a rollback story, or a stated decision that there is none and what a user does instead. REQUIRED: the version is derived from one source shared with PW-0501. IF SIGNING IS UNAVAILABLE the update path must be disabled by default and say so, rather than shipping an unverified one -- an unsigned auto-updater is worse than no updater, and that dependency goes to LAST_MILE rather than being worked around.
